title.en: Aquatic browsing and giant terrestrial browsing comparison
title.zh: 水栖取食与巨型陆栖取食比较

description.en: A reproducible entry point for comparing two richly described lineages without treating the interface as a phylogenetic result.
description.zh: 用于比较两个具有丰富档案的谱系的可复现入口；界面本身不构成系统发育结论。

limitations: Comparison fields inherit each claim, range and occurrence source boundary; visible differences are not tests of evolutionary causation.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Perissodactyla time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的奇蹄类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Perissodactyla interval in the diversity view to inspect bundled sample counts, not an estimate of total richness.
description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的奇蹄类区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.

title.zh: PETM 奇蹄类证据时间点

description.en: Open the 56 Ma map setting linked to the PETM sample that anchors the Perissodactyla navigation envelope.
description.zh: 打开与奇蹄目导航延限锚定的 PETM 样本相连的 5600 万年前地图时间点。

limitations: The PETM setting is a rounded earliest sampled record in this source-bounded navigation envelope, not a crown age, exact origin, global first appearance, direct ancestor or spatial co-registration.

title.zh: 三趾马旧大陆扩散窗口

description.en: Open the 11.2 Ma map setting for the Vienna Basin Old World hipparionin dispersal window recorded by the review.
description.zh: 打开综述所记录的维也纳盆地旧大陆三趾马扩散窗口（1120 万年前）地图时间点。

limitations: This is a selected Vienna Basin regional dispersal window, not a global Hipparionini first appearance, complete distribution, lineage duration, direct ancestry or fossil-locality map.

description.en: Open the 26.5 Ma map setting linked to the dated Paraceratherium linxiaense LX1808 material from the Linxia Basin.
description.zh: 打开与临夏盆地定年为 2650 万年前的副巨犀 Paraceratherium linxiaense LX1808 材料相连的地图时间点。

limitations: The point range is the dated Linxia LX1808 occurrence, not a genus-wide FAD or LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestor or exact palaeogeographic locality.

title.zh: 短腿犀 Ashfall 证据时间点

description.en: Open the 11.86 Ma map setting for the dated Ashfall Teleoceras major sample within its North American regional envelope.
description.zh: 打开北美区域延限内定年为 1186 万年前的 Ashfall 短腿犀 Teleoceras major 样本地图时间点。

limitations: This route retains the 11.86 ± 0.13 Ma Ashfall sample within a North American species envelope; it does not establish a global range, uniform behavior, direct ancestry or a reconstructed collection locality.

description.en: Open the 0.0144 Ma map setting linked to the directly dated 14.4 ka Coelodonta antiquitatis individual.
description.zh: 打开与直接定年为 1.44 万年前的披毛犀 Coelodonta antiquitatis 个体相连的 0.0144 Ma 地图时间点。

limitations: The 14.4 ka point is one directly dated northern Eurasian individual, not the genus-wide or global last appearance, extinction time, complete distribution, direct ancestry or exact map locality.
